title: Code note
description: A note on the code: one file .code-notes/<id>.json, a comment thread on some lines, a whole file or a folder (media/notes-README.template.md).
$comment: From src/core/format/noteModel.ts noteProblem and parseNote. Required: file, messages (at least one, each with a body), and range unless target is set. Unknown fields are allowed: the extension keeps them and writes them back. Lenient fallbacks of the reader not described here: a selection with non-number columns, an unknown role, a malformed event (each dropped when read). severity is any string: the extension knows high, medium, low and nit, and keeps any other value ("critical") in the file without an error, showing it as none. Not expressible here: range.end >= range.start; range and anchor are ignored when target is set.

version.description: The note format version: 1 (a file without it is version 1).

id.description: The note's id; the file name (<id>.json) is what counts.

file.description: The code file (or folder, with target), relative to the workspace folder.

anchor.description: The lines the note is about and the lines around them, to follow the code (leave out or {} to let the extension fill it).

commit.description: The git commit it was written on.

branch.description: The git branch it was written on.

selection.description: The exact text selected, when the note is about part of a line.

anyOf.description: The selected text and its columns.

startCol.description: Its first column on the range's first line (0-based).

session.description: A name that groups notes (one review, one topic).

status.description: Whether the note is open or resolved (default open).

stale.description: The code at range changed since the note was written.

claudeSession.description: The Claude Code session that answered this note (follow-ups resume it).

severity.description: For review findings: how much it matters: high, medium, low or nit.

target.description: A note on a whole file or folder (no range or anchor then).

journey.description: Set on a question asked from a journey step.

n.description: The step's number when the question was asked.

anyOf.description: A note on lines: it has a range.
A note on a whole file or folder.

role.description: Whether a person or an agent wrote it.

event.description: A status change: who resolved or reopened the note, and when.

role.description: Whether a person or an agent did it.
